name: Personal Dotfiles
description: Clones mt-empty/dotfiles and runs its install_devcontainer.sh. Hardcoded to one repo on purpose — this is a personal feature, not a generic reusable one. The clone+run step is a postCreateCommand, not install.sh, so it re-executes live on every container creation instead of baking into a cached Docker layer: push a commit to the dotfiles repo and the next container/rebuild picks it up, no version bump or cache-busting needed. All actual bootstrap steps live solely in the dotfiles repo, not duplicated here.
postCreateCommand: bash -c 'd="$HOME/dotfiles"; if [ -d "$d/.git" ]; then git -C "$d" fetch --depth 1 origin master && git -C "$d" checkout -q FETCH_HEAD || echo ">>> [dotfiles] WARNING: fetch failed, using existing checkout"; else git clone --depth 1 --branch master https://github.com/mt-empty/dotfiles.git "$d"; fi; chmod +x "$d/install_devcontainer.sh"; (cd "$d" && bash ./install_devcontainer.sh) || echo ">>> [dotfiles] WARNING: install_devcontainer.sh exited non-zero"'
